prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with damage to the left front quarter, including a cracked headlamp assembly, a deformed fender with a bent support bracket, and scuffing along the bumper cover that continues onto the wheel arch. The forward radiator support shows a slight shift, though it is not fully clear whether every mark seen here resulted from this impact, and a closer teardown may help separate the old from the new. The proposed plan replaces the headlamp and fender, straightens the bracket, and refinishes the affected panels. Labor hours are consistent with the damage described. The repair billing shows no repeated charges, and no prior damage to this vehicle is known to the appraiser.
